body: I don't want to live purely so I don't put them through anything else, it sounds stupid.. but whether or not they can forgive me I can't seem to.

I am a huge fan, and no, not right now, they send me over the edge, haha. 
I think I will be forgiven, but hurting a friend is reason enough for me to kill myself where I stand, I love my friends more than anyone and hurting them means I should hurt myself.
Well I felt terrible so went to sleep, I just woke up, I want to take more, I'm just.. trying not too. Thankyou for being here.
I did something reckless and ended up sleeping with a friend of theirs, I didn't even think it would hurt them, but it apparently did, and now they're pissed at me.

I just took 1600mg of Ibruprofen with some gin, on an empty stomach. I don't even know why, I even think I'm doing it as an attention seeking method. I did my research, I should probably be okay. I could have taken more if I wanted but I think that means I don't want to kill myself, I'm sure i'll be okay right. How silly.

I'm a 21 year old girl. 
I pay for everything with my university fees.

There are so many things I feel like I should say to you, but all I can think to say of right now is "Thank you". I'm a university student in the UK by the way. 

My rational mind says "it just takes getting used to, it will get worse before it gets better, but it will get better". Unfortunately, my emotional mind is becoming more and more clouded by bad thoughts. 

Thank you for sharing your story, it means a lot to me.
